title: EntityChangeMeta
description: Metadata about entity changes including transaction information and change type.

transactionId.description: UUID of the transaction that made this change.

user.description: User who made the change: the attributed principal.

attributedKind.description: Kind of the attributed principal in user. Open value set; known values are user, service and system. Absent when the change recorded no attribution.

executedBy.description: The principal that executed the change, independent of attribution: for an on-behalf-of request, the on-behalf-of client. Absent when the change recorded no attribution.

kind.description: Kind of the executing principal. Open value set; known values are user, service and system.

changeType.description: Type of change that was made to the entity.

fieldsChangedCount.description: Number of fields changed in the entity for this change.
